headline: ArcelorMittal Reports Nearly $4 Billion Investment in Liberia
summary: ArcelorMittal reported nearly $4 billion in investments as the company eyes 40 more years of operations in Liberia.
why: Large-scale mining concessions form a vital component of foreign direct investment and mineral export earnings for Liberia.
